question: [Behavior][Nice-to-have] Is the Lifecycle stage / Status transition on a contact subject to rules (e.g. required Lost reason, forbidden jumps) that could not be observed without saving?
csvAnswer: If the Lifecycle stage is Lost, then Lost reason is mandatory, else no restrictions

question: [Behavior][Nice-to-have] What do the bulk actions (Update field, Assign to, Add tags, More actions) do, and which are permitted for this role, on multiple records?
navigation: Contacts > select row > Bulk actions (flow contact-bulk-actions)
csvAnswer: All Bulk actions which are visible to the user are permitted for the user. By RBAC design, if any action is not authorised for a user, then that respective CTAs are hidden to them.

question: [Behavior][Blocking] What are the duplicate rules on Save: does creating a contact with an existing email get blocked or only warned?
navigation: Contacts > Add contact > Check for duplicates (flow create-contact)
csvAnswer: Contacts with duplicate emails get blocked.

question: [Scope][Nice-to-have] What are the Import contacts file requirements and expected mapping behaviour?
csvAnswer: Import contact modal accepts CSV or xlsx files, Auto mapping will be done if there are any exact matches between the csv header and the Contact fields, else user can map the fields as per their needs. Any already auto mapped fields can also be changed by the user.

question: [Behavior][Nice-to-have] Is the Email field on contacts mandatory on save despite the Required checkbox appearing unchecked (only Quick-add/Read-only/Unique badges seen)?
navigation: Contacts > Add contact > Save with Email empty (flow create-contact); Admin Settings > Contacts > Email
csvAnswer: Either Email / mobile / External ID is mandatory
